title: Turning off the switch still shows today's warning with no customer count
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: One sales representative holds both service fields of a customer, and you start to turn their "Sales Representative" switch off.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-B} and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: {Sales-rep-B}'s staff record is open in Settings > Staff in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, with the "Sales Representative" switch on.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Turn the "Sales Representative" switch off and read the "Turn Off Sales Representative" warning.
  2. Cancel the warning.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "Turn Off Sales Representative" warning shows as it does today, with no customer count.
  • Step 2: the switch stays on and nothing changes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R21: “The Deactivate window, shown before deactivating a sales representative's account, counts every customer where they are in the first field, Service Parts or Part Sales, counting each customer once, and reads "They will be removed as sales representative from {n} customer{s}.", with "customer" when {n} is 1 and "customers" otherwise, in place of today's "Their customer assignments will stay where they are." The "Turn Off Sales Representative" warning, shown when the Sales Representative switch is turned off, does not change and shows no count (S4-N2).”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 13: “13. (a) Only the Deactivate window; the Turn Off Sales Representative warning stays as it is.”
